meta.title: Sidebar day groups
meta.description: Takes over the whole sidebar session list and sections it by day (today, yesterday, exact dates), with pinned sessions in their own section and collapsible groups. It replaces the built-in sidebar implementation rather than patching it, so a DSH upgrade needs no patch porting as long as the slot contract holds. The tradeoff is that built-in sidebar interactions must be rebuilt; this version ships the session list, day grouping, collapsing, click-to-open and the pinned mark.
